The '''Brakan Approach''' was the name given to the southern edge of the [[Aboro Mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], where Aboro was connected to the [[Brakan Mesa]] to the south by a [[light bridge]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Brakan Approach appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2012]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
